title: euodia incisifolia
intro: Euodia incisifolia, commonly known as Fenzhi or Japanese pepper tree, is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Euodia incisifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Euodia incisifolia include limonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
